_comment: Track presets for select_tracked.py. Each maps a name to a selector resolved against the committed market snapshot (full_items.json): 'all' selects every marketable item (guarded -- confirmation required); 'main' selects a whole main category; 'main'+'sub' selects one sub-category; 'set' selects a named set from track_sets.json. An optional 'min_grade'/'max_grade' limits the preset to a grade band (0 White,1 Green,2 Blue,3 Gold,4 Orange,5 Violet); the accessory presets default to grade>=3 (high-value) since this project targets valuable items. The --min-grade/--max-grade CLI flags override these defaults (pass --min-grade 0 to re-include every grade). Names are official-faithful per node (Central Market label per node): main categories keep their collective label (accessories = main 20; pearl = main 55 'Pearl Items'), sub-categories use the singular leaf label (ring 20:1, necklace 20:2, earring 20:3, belt 20:4, functional 55:6).
